description: Refund one or more line items on an order. Can refund to original payment or as store credit, optionally restocking inventory.

refund.description: Shopify refund object. Typical: currency, notify (boolean), note, shipping ({amount} or {full_refund: true}), refund_line_items (array of {line_item_id, quantity, restock_type: 'no_restock' | 'cancel' | 'return'}), transactions (array of {parent_id, amount, kind: 'refund', gateway}).
